summary: Haleon plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting, a routine corporate governance event. The filing discloses poll voting outcomes on standard resolutions including receiving annual report, approving director remuneration, re-electing directors, reappointing auditors, and authorizing share allotment and share buybacks. No special situation, merger, acquisition, activist campaign, or strategic change is indicated. The AGM results are ordinary business of a publicly traded company and do not trigger a special-situations classification.
